vpn-lab-server.name: VPN lab server (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
vpn-lab-server.notes: The VPN endpoint of the vpn-lab (vms/labs/vpn-lab/): WireGuard and OpenVPN installed, nothing configured; the exercises build the tunnels by hand. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image, ready in about a minute. Ported from qlab's vpn-lab (labuser became the profile's user, the LAN moved from 192.168.100.0/24, which vmctl link uses, to 172.20.1.0/24).

post_install_run: command -v wg wg-quick openvpn tcpdump iptables

vpn-lab-client.name: VPN lab client (Ubuntu 24.04 cloud image)
vpn-lab-client.notes: The client of the vpn-lab (vms/labs/vpn-lab/): connects to vpn-lab-server over the lab segment and through the tunnels the exercises build. Ubuntu 24.04 minimal cloud image.

post_install_run: command -v wg wg-quick openvpn tcpdump iptables
